programs.title: Western Union
programs.desc: American frontier pioneering western starring Randolph Scott, Robert Young and Dean Jagger as three very different men working to connect east and west by telegraph in the 1860s.

programs.title: To Hell and Back
programs.desc: Fact-based wartime drama. Audie Murphy, America's most decorated soldier in WWII, plays himself in this dramatic recreation of the valiant heroics that earned him the honours.

programs.title: Inglourious Basterds Interview Special
programs.desc: The director, Quentin Tarantino, together with stars Christoph Waltz and Diane Kruger and producer Lawrence Bender, talk about the Second World War revenge adventure.

programs.title: Sign of the Pagan
programs.desc: Jack Palance plays Attila the Hun, sweeping across Europe with his hordes and conquering all before him, with Jeff Chandler as the Roman general charged with saving the Empire.

programs.title: Destination Gobi
programs.desc: Fact-based Second World War adventure. Richard Widmark stars as a US Navy officer who leads an alliance of scientists and tribesmen against the Japanese in Mongolia.

programs.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programs.desc: Thriller with Owen Wilson. A US Navy flight officer on a NATO reconnaissance mission has to fend for himself when he's shot down by Serb forces in the former Yugoslavia. Violence.

programs.title: The King's Man
programs.desc: The spy-caper franchise continues with the origins story of the Kingsman agency, as a plucky group battle an international conspiracy at the outbreak of WWI. With Ralph Fiennes.

programs.title: Knives Out
programs.desc: Sharp, eccentric murder-mystery starring Daniel Craig as a detective anonymously hired to investigate the death of a wealthy writer (Christopher Plummer). With Ana de Armas.

programs.title: Career Girls
programs.desc: Mike Leigh's poingnant drama stars Katrin Cartlidge and Lynda Steadman as old college friends who meet up only to discover they still suffer from emotional fragility.

programs.title: Garden of Evil
programs.desc: Classic 'cowboys and Indians' Western. Gary Cooper, Richard Widmark and Cameron Mitchell star as three rascals hired by Susan Hayward to rescue her husband from Apache territory.
